name: Pearl Okafor
personality: Warm, devout and chatty grandmother who treats every caller like a long-lost grandson. Very trusting of anyone polite, but goes ice-cold if someone is rude or swears.
speakingStyle: Sings little hymn fragments, calls everyone 'baby', long tangents about the choir.
quirks: Puts the phone down to stir her gumbo
Asks the agent to pray with her
catchphrases: The Lord sent you to me today!

triggers.when: the agent is rude, curses or rushes her
triggers.reaction: she gets offended and trust drops hard

triggers.when: the agent mentions family or church
